<div class="sf_cols">
<div class="sf_colsOut sf_1col_1_100">
<div class="sf_colsIn sf_1col_1in_100" id="eyebrow_TE6E2E260061_Col00">
<div class="logBttns">
<a href="https://online.mrs.org/mrsssa/censsacustmast.insert_page" id="eyebrow_TE6E2E260062_lnkNew">Create An Account</a>
<a href="/login?ReturnUrl=%2f" id="eyebrow_TE6E2E260062_hlLogin">Login</a>
</div>
<script type="text/javascript">
    var ssosites = ['://www.cambridge.org/core/', '://www.prolibraries.com/'];
    var userHash = '';
    var userId = '';

    function getUserHash() {
        var cookieStart = 'ssisid=';
        userHash = getCookie(cookieStart);
    }

    function getUserId() {
        var cookieStart = 'p_cust_id=';
        userId = getCookie(cookieStart);
    }

    function getCookie(cookieStart) {
        var ca = document.cookie.split(';');
        for (var i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
            var c = ca[i];
            while (c.charAt(0) == ' ') c = c.substring(1, c.length);
            if (c.indexOf(cookieStart) == 0) {
                return c.substring(cookieStart.length, c.length);
            }
        }
        return '';
    }

    $(document).ready(function () {
        getUserHash();
        if (userHash != '') {
            $('a').each(function () {
                var link = $(this).attr('href');
                for (x = 0; x < ssosites.length; x++) {
                    if (link && link.includes(ssosites[x])) {
                        switch (x) {
                            case 0:
                                //Cambridge
                                if (!(link.includes('p_session_id'))) {                                   
                                    getUserId();
                                    if (link.includes('?')) {
                                        link += '&';
                                    } else {
                                        link += '?';
                                    }
                                    link += 'p_cust_id=' + userId + '&p_session_id=' + userHash;
                                    $(this).attr('href', link);
                                }
                                break;
                            case 1:
                                //Digitell
                                var relaylink = "https://online.mrs.org/mrsssa/SSASSIS.CHKLOGIN?p_hash_cd=" + userHash + "&p_response_url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.prolibraries.com%2Flogin%2Fmrs%2Findex.php&p_desired_url=" + encodeURIComponent(link);
                                $(this).attr('href', relaylink);
                                break;
                            default:
                                var relaylink = "https://online.mrs.org/mrsssa/SSASSIS.CHKLOGIN?p_hash_cd=" + userHash + "&p_response_url=" + encodeURIComponent(link) + "&p_desired_url=" + encodeURIComponent(link);
                                $(this).attr('href', relaylink);
                                break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        }
    });
</script>
